meaning:
ἐπι-λύω
[in Aq.: Gen.40:8 41:8, 12; Th.: Hos.3:4 * ;]
1. to loose, release.
2. to solve, settle, explain: Mrk.4:34, Act.19:39.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
